text: dsh-appearance-glass 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的界面外观插件，通过设置页和主题 token 覆写调整主面板、侧栏、卡片与输入框、菜单与浮层的透明度，并提供透明背景策略和可自定义的内置渐层壁纸。插件在设置侧栏提供独立页面，也在插件设置中提供同一组控件；透明度滑杆按界面叠层换算合成后的目标值，壁纸包含底色、三个色彩区域和强度选项。适合希望让 DSH 网页界面透出桌面背景或更换背景色彩的用户。需要 DSH 0.2.0 或更新版本，不需要额外 API 密钥或账号。

dsh-appearance-glass adjusts opacity for the DSH web interface's panels, sidebar, content surfaces, and overlays. Its settings page offers backdrop choices and a customizable wallpaper. Opacity values account for overlapping layers. Requires DSH 0.2.0 or later; no API key or account is needed.
我想把 DSH 网页界面的背景调得更透明。
能不能单独调整侧栏和聊天区域的透明度？
让 DSH 的菜单和提示浮层也能透出桌面背景。
我想给界面换一张颜色可以自己调的壁纸。
怎样只让输入框和卡片变透，不改其他区域？
DSH 外观怎么快速切换成纯透明背景？
How can I make the DSH web interface more transparent?
I want a custom colorful wallpaper behind my panels and menus.
dsh-appearance-glass 的功能「分区透明度」：分别调节主面板、侧栏、内容表面和菜单浮层的不透明度。用户在设置页拖动对应滑杆，插件将目标合成透明度换算为主题 token 的 alpha 值。
dsh-appearance-glass 的功能「背景与壁纸」：设置自动背景、内置壁纸或纯透明模式，并可编辑底色、三个色彩区域及壁纸强度。通过界面外观设置页调整，壁纸绘制到页面背景。
dsh-appearance-glass 的功能「设置面板」：在 DSH 设置侧栏注册独立的界面外观页面，并在插件设置区域呈现同一套控制面板。用户可从任一入口编辑当前配置。

dsh-appearance-glass README · What you get：- **Four independent opacity sliders** — main panel / sidebar / cards & inputs / menus & popovers.
  The value is the **composited** result: 20% really looks like 20% (see the math below).
- **Built-in wallpaper** — three colour blobs, a base colour, a strength, five palettes, and a live preview
  whose mock surfaces use the real tokens with the real layer count.
- **A kill switch** — turn “Enabled” off to compare instantly; nothing is uninstalled.

dsh-appearance-glass README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-appearance-glass          # from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:david0304git/dsh-appearance-glass   # from GitHub
```

Requirements: `dsh >= 0.2.0` (`engines.dsh`); tested on 0.2.1-rc.2.
The only peer dependency is `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (provided by the host, marked `optional`).

dsh-appearance-glass README · Finding it in a plugin market：- **Official Discover**: `plugin_market` reads the index URLs *you* add (DSH ships none). Two that work:
  - `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json` — the awesome-dsh-plugin list as a format-1 index
  - `https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/index.json`
- **dsh-market** (`dshmarket`): only installs from the awesome-dsh-plugin list, so this plugin has to be listed there first.

text:
dsh-appearance-glass README · Settings page：1. **Header** — title, `customised in this profile` badge, write status, **Enabled** (official `Switch`), **Reset to defaults**
2. **Interface opacity** — four sliders (main panel / sidebar / cards & inputs / menus & popovers) plus a **Sync** button that copies the main-panel value to the other three
3. **See-through backdrop** — Auto / Built-in wallpaper / Pure transparent
4. **Built-in wallpaper** — live preview, then four aligned rows: **blobs** (three colour pills), **base** (colour pill + follow light/dark), **strength** (slider pill), **palette** (five 44 px gradient cards; the one in effect gets a focus ring)

dsh-appearance-glass README · Parameters：| Field | Range | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Master switch; `false` leaves every token alone |
| `opacityBase` | 0–100 % | 68 | Main panel (the conversation background is painted twice — see below) |
| `opacitySidebar` | 0–100 % | 68 | Sidebar and its selection states (the shell adds a 40% tint on top) |
| `opacitySurface` | 0–100 % | 68 | Cards, inputs, message bubbles, code blocks |
| `opacityOverlay` | 0–100 % | 72 | Menus, tooltips, toasts, popovers |
| `backdrop` | `auto` / `wallpaper` / `none` | `auto` | `auto` uses the native window material on desktop and the wallpaper elsewhere |
| `wallpaperA/B/C` | `#rrggbb` or `auto` | `auto` | The three blobs; `auto` follows light/dark |
| `wallpaperBase` | `#rrggbb` or `auto` | `auto` | Base colour; `auto` = `#e9f0ff` light / `#0b0f1c` dark |
| `wallpaperStrength` | 10–100 | 58 | Blob strength (the 2nd and 3rd are automatically weaker) |

dsh-appearance-glass README · Why the slider value is the composited opacity：The same token is often painted more than once: on macOS the shell's `.centerCol` **and** the conversation root
both draw `--dsw-alias-bg-base`. Setting that token to 68% would show `1-(1-0.68)² = 89.8%` — which is why
“turn it all the way down” used to look barely transparent.

The plugin therefore solves for the per-layer value (`a = 1-(1-target)^(1/depth)`):
section: Why the slider value is the composited opacity

text:
dsh-appearance-glass README · Why the slider value is the composited opacity：| Region | Real layers | Slider 20% writes | Composited |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Main panel | 2 | 11% | 20.0% |
| Sidebar | ~1.4 | 13% | ~20% |
| Cards / inputs | 1 | 20% | 20.0% |
| Menus / popovers | 1 | 20% | 20.0% |

The per-token deltas shrink with the target too, so low values are not pulled back up.
section: Why the slider value is the composited opacity

text:
dsh-appearance-glass README · Why macOS gets real see-through：The DSH desktop window is created with `vibrancy: 'sidebar'` and `backgroundColor: '#00000000'`, and the shipped CSS
makes html/body transparent on `html[data-platform=darwin]`. **The desktop material is always there — it is simply
covered by opaque panels.** Swapping those surface tokens for translucent colours lets it through; this is not a
CSS imitation.

dsh-appearance-glass README · Why macOS gets real see-through：> The system material's own blur cannot be turned off: it is an Electron main-process window property, and no
> renderer IPC exposes it (`DESKTOP_IPC` only has `nativeThemeSet` for light/dark and `windowsAppearance` for
> Windows title bars). For a completely unblurred result, open DSH in a browser.

dsh-appearance-glass README · Implementation notes：- Everything is a **theme token override** (`ctx.theme.overrideTokens`); official components consume `--dsw-*`,
  so no hashed class name is involved.
- Only the wallpaper touches `<html>` (`background-image`). The plugin never adds `backdrop-filter` to a
  container — that would create a containing block for `position: fixed` descendants, and DSH menus render in
  place with CSS anchor positioning.
- The UI is built from official shapes (selector pill 36 px, `--dsw-radius-md`, `--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`),
  the official `Menu` and `Switch` primitives, with native `<select>` / text-button fallbacks.
- Fail-open everywhere: without theme/slots/locale/configForms nothing is registered and nothing changes.

dsh-appearance-glass README · Tests：```sh
npm test        # node test/run.mjs — host 7 + client 33 + tokens 4
```

`test/tokens.test.mjs` reads the installed DSH `app.asar`, extracts the official token table and checks every
token this plugin overrides — a DSH upgrade that renames a token fails the suite immediately.
(Verified against DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, 403 official tokens.)

dsh-appearance-glass README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause / fix |
| --- | --- |
| A control is greyed out | That field is not served by the host yet — usually a host-half change without a DSH restart. The header says so |
| Nothing changes | Check the “Enabled” switch, then whether the backdrop is `none` |
| No desktop visible (macOS) | Layer compensation is handled; make sure DSH is the desktop app, not a browser tab (browsers have no window material, only the wallpaper) |
| Old `mode` / `blur` / `saturate` keys in the config | Leftovers from 1.0; harmless, delete them if you like |

dsh-appearance-glass README · Icon and sidebar glyph：`icon.svg` is declared through `package.json`'s `icon` (the official contract: a relative path, SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP,
≤256 KiB; the host inlines it as a `data:` URL and shows it at 48×48).

dsh-appearance-glass README · Icon and sidebar glyph：The **settings sidebar glyph** is hard-coded in the shell (`navIcon(id)`: only account / models / agent-presets /
plugins / archived-sessions have their own glyph, everything else falls back to the gear), and
`settings.section` has no icon field. This plugin therefore uses a minimal DOM patch that replaces the glyph in
**its own row only**: it locates the row by its label in all three languages, saves the original `innerHTML`,
restores it on dispose, observes only `body.childList` (the settings panel is a portal subtree), and does nothing
at all if the structure does not match.

dsh-appearance-glass README · 你能得到什么：- **四个区域各自可调的不透明度** —— 主界面／侧栏／卡片与输入框／菜单与浮层。

- **一个总开关** —— 关掉「启用」就能立刻对比，不需要卸载。

dsh-appearance-glass README · 设置页结构：1. **标题栏** —— 标题、`本 profile 已自定义` 徽章、写入状态、**启用**（官方 `Switch`）、**恢复默认**
2. **界面不透明度** —— 四根滑杆（主界面／侧栏／卡片与输入框／菜单与浮层）＋ **同步** 按钮（把主界面的值一次应用到其他三项）
3. **透视背景** —— 自动／内置壁纸／纯透明
4. **内置壁纸** —— 实时预览，然后四列对齐的控件：**色块**（三颗颜色 pill）、**底色**（颜色 pill ＋ 跟随深浅色）、**强度**（滑杆 pill）、**配色**（五张 44px 渐变卡，命中时外圈一圈 focus 蓝）

dsh-appearance-glass README · 参数：| 字段 | 范围 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | 布尔 | `true` | 总开关；`false` 时不动任何 token |
| `opacityBase` | 0–100 % | 68 | 主界面（对话区底色实际被叠了两层，见下节） |
| `opacitySidebar` | 0–100 % | 68 | 侧栏与其选中态（官方在栏上另加一层 40% 底色） |
| `opacitySurface` | 0–100 % | 68 | 卡片、输入框、消息气泡、代码块 |
| `opacityOverlay` | 0–100 % | 72 | 菜单、tooltip、toast、浮层 |
| `backdrop` | `auto` / `wallpaper` / `none` | `auto` | `auto`＝桌面版用系统窗口材质，其他环境铺壁纸 |
| `wallpaperA/B/C` | `#rrggbb` 或 `auto` | `auto` | 三颗色块；`auto` 跟随深浅色 |
| `wallpaperBase` | `#rrggbb` 或 `auto` | `auto` | 底色；`auto`＝浅色 `#e9f0ff`／深色 `#0b0f1c` |
| `wallpaperStrength` | 10–100 | 58 | 色块强度（第二、三颗自动比第一颗弱） |

dsh-appearance-glass README · 为什么滑杆数值就是合成后的透明度：同一块底色常被叠好几层：macOS 下官方的 `.centerCol` 与对话区 root **各画一次** `--dsw-alias-bg-base`。
直接把 token 设成 68%，实际看到的是 `1-(1-0.68)² = 89.8%` —— 这就是「调到最低还是看不透」的原因。

所以插件用真实层数反推单层值（`a = 1-(1-target)^(1/depth)`）：

| 区域 | 真实叠层 | 滑杆 20% 时写入 | 实际合成 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 主界面 | 2 | 11% | 20.0% |
| 侧栏 | ~1.4 | 13% | ~20% |
| 卡片／输入框 | 1 | 20% | 20.0% |
| 菜单／浮层 | 1 | 20% | 20.0% |

同一区内的相对加权（delta）也会跟着目标值等比缩小，低透明度时不会被拉回去。
section: 为什么滑杆数值就是合成后的透明度

text:
dsh-appearance-glass README · 为什么 macOS 上是「真的透」：DSH 桌面版主窗口以 `vibrancy: 'sidebar'` + `backgroundColor: '#00000000'` 创建，官方 CSS 在
`html[data-platform=darwin]` 下把 html/body 背景设成 transparent。**桌面材质一直都在，只是被各面板的
不透明背景盖住**；本插件把那些表面的 token 换成半透明色，原生材质就透出来 —— 不是 CSS 假装的效果。

> 系统窗口材质本身的模糊**关不掉**：那是 Electron 主进程的窗口属性，renderer 端没有任何 IPC 能改
> （`DESKTOP_IPC` 只有主题色与 Windows 标题栏上色）。想要完全零模糊，请用浏览器打开 DSH。
section: 为什么 macOS 上是「真的透」

text:
dsh-appearance-glass README · 实现方式：- 主要手段是 **theme token 覆写**（`ctx.theme.overrideTokens`）：官方组件自己消费 `--dsw-*`，
  所以不依赖任何 hash 过的 class 名。
- 只有壁纸会碰 `<html>`（`background-image`）。插件**不对任何容器加 `backdrop-filter`** ——
  容器一旦有它，就会成为 `position: fixed` 子元素的 containing block，而 DSH 的菜单用
  CSS anchor positioning 就地渲染，会有定位风险。
- UI 全部由官方元件组成（selector pill 36px、`--dsw-radius-md`、`--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`），
  菜单用官方 `Menu`、开关用官方 `Switch`；取不到时退化成原生 `<select>`／文字按钮。
- 全部 fail-open：找不到 theme/slots/locale/configForms 就不注册、什么都不改。

dsh-appearance-glass README · 测试：```sh
npm test        # node test/run.mjs —— host 7 + client 33 + token 4
```

`test/tokens.test.mjs` 会读取本机安装的 DSH `app.asar`，把官方 token 表抽出来，逐一核对本插件覆写的
每一个 token —— DSH 升级后 token 改名会立刻被抓到（实测 0.2.1-rc.2，403 个官方 token）。

dsh-appearance-glass README · 疑难解答：| 症状 | 原因与处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 某个控件置灰 | 该字段还没被宿主服务（通常是改了 Host 半但没重启）。标题栏会说明 |
| 完全没变化 | 看「启用」是否关着，再看「透视背景」是不是 `none` |
| 看不见桌面（macOS） | 层数补偿已处理；确认用的是桌面版而不是浏览器（浏览器没有窗口材质，只能铺壁纸） |
| 配置里残留 `mode` / `blur` / `saturate` | 1.0 留下的键，**不影响运行**；想清掉就手动删 |

dsh-appearance-glass README · 图标与侧栏字形：`icon.svg` 由 `package.json` 的 `icon` 声明（官方契约：相对路径、只收 svg/png/jpg/webp、≤256 KiB；
宿主 inline 成 `data:` URL，以 48×48 显示）。

**设置侧栏的导航图标**在 shell 里是**硬编码**的（`navIcon(id)`：只有 account／models／agent-presets／
plugins／archived-sessions 有专属图标，其余一律齿轮），而 `settings.section` 没有 icon 字段。
所以本插件用一个**最小的 DOM 补丁**只替换**自己那一列**的字形：用三种语言的导航文字定位、保存原始
`innerHTML`、卸载时完整还原、只订阅 `body.childList`（设置面板是 portal 到 body 的新子树）、
结构不符就什么都不做。

dsh-appearance-glass README · 发布：| 步骤 | 指令 |
| --- | --- |
| 打封包自检 | `npm pack --dry-run` |
| 发布 | `npm login && npm publish --access public`（`prepublishOnly` 会先跑测试） |
| GitHub release | `gh release create v1.1.x dist/dsh-appearance-glass.tgz` |
| 投稿市场 | 给 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 开 PR，新增 `data/plugins/david0304git__dsh-appearance-glass.yml` |

投稿文件在 `submit/awesome-dsh-plugin.yml`；仓库声明了 `dsh.bundle`，所以 `dsh plugin add` 能直接安装。
没有任何 `prepare`／`postinstall` 脚本，源码安装不需要建置授权。
